seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: A ragtag party forms at the Sin and Tonic, takes courier and investigation work, and uncovers a conspiracy of Ugathul infiltrators, Embercall radar dishes, and a necromancer named Grayson operating out of an impossible underground manor.

seasons.title: Rainbow's End
seasons.arc_summary: A disastrous ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead; Johnny and Benny are resurrected through the mysterious Black and White, Argyle is permanently lost, and the reformed party hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, uncovering a cosmic invasion plan by six new gods.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The party rescues Anaïs, learns of the cosmic Narrative siblings, attends a massive pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost to compete for a keystone, and navigates art heists, demon assassins, and rival factions to claim their prize — even as a half-returned Argyle walks back through the door.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: With Argyle's return confirmed and six months of downtime behind them, the party descends into the sewers beneath Teller's Run and discovers a hairline fracture in reality itself — a parallel world imprisoning a two-mile-tall deity — then bombs the research operation before fleeing the collapsing underground.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Iconoclasm boards a colossal arachnid Strider alongside nineteen rival organizations for a voidward pilgrimage, building alliances and surviving lethal weekly tithes while exploring the Undercroft to forge an alliance with the ancient Machine God and assault the Herald's cultists within the machine.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Cagley Terror
seasons.arc_summary: Four 8th-grade heroes descend into the Terror of Cagley's lair and slay the shadow demon, saving the town of Cagley. This concludes Noah's middle-school one-shot.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Iridescent Church convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a mysterious visitor, tracking a Feyrock necklace deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they battle fey creatures, rescue a child, and confront a masked fey court before discovering the murder suspect is already dead—yet the huskification curse continues. The trail leads back to Hallia, where they uncover a ritual transmuting corpses into fey stone via the Gloaming Codex and are pulled into the book's pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: A newly-formed Sedecium fire team — Scrazzy, Foral, and Ozzie — is sent into a slip-damaged orbital observatory to follow a lead from the mysterious 'entity.' They free a tortured ship AI, rotate the station out of the slip, and uncover that the Thessian Esoterica (formerly Gremory) recently accessed records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement, the fire team boards a Sundom planet-killer warship on a desperate raid to steal divine essence from the freshly-killed Thessian 'Tithe' before the God Eater Harrow finishes devouring it — navigating slip-puzzles and spider temples to become the only team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
